scopeNote.description: State the actual scope, assumptions and exclusions. If the user supplies no scope, development-self-test-v1 is the example; explicit user scope takes precedence. The control plane does not judge or rewrite scope.

devDays.description: Optional Agent-supplied non-negative effort in person-days. Stored as supplied; the service does not calculate, replace or reconcile totals.

testDays.description: Optional Agent-supplied non-negative effort in person-days. Stored as supplied; the service does not calculate, replace or reconcile totals.

totalDays.description: Optional Agent-supplied non-negative effort in person-days. Stored as supplied; the service does not calculate, replace or reconcile totals.

items.description: Nonempty estimated page/interface items based on materials. No fixed item count is prescribed.

name.description: Canonical item name. Runtime validation also accepts feature/title aliases without rewriting the original payload.

type.description: Canonical type values. Runtime validation accepts documented page/API synonyms without normalizing the saved payload.

testDays.description: Self-test effort in person-days. Runtime validation accepts qaDays as an alias without rewriting the original payload.

totalDays.description: Optional Agent-supplied non-negative total, retained as supplied; not derived or reconciled by the service.

complexity.description: Optional Agent-supplied complexity label. Producers may use SIMPLE/MEDIUM/COMPLEX; other textual labels are retained without normalization.

detail.description: Optional detailed explanation, retained as supplied.
